item.title: PCM Boys Wrestling Goes 2-1 at Home Quad Saturday
item.description: The PCM boys wrestling team went 2-1 at a home quadrangular on Saturday. The Mustangs defeated Mid-Prairie 68-6 and Sigourney-Keota 42-28, and fell to Carlisle 63-9. Tucker Wheeler and Mason Hjortshoj both went 3-0 at the quad.
